android.desc:
Turn your phone into a powerful screen mirroring and casting companion with Smart View for Samsung TV. Mirror your mobile screen, cast videos and photos, enjoy games on the big screen, and connect your phone to your compatible Smart TV over the same Wi-Fi network.

Whether you want to watch a video, share photos with family, play a mobile game on a larger display, or mirror your phone screen, Smart View makes it easy to bring your mobile content to your TV.

📺 Screen Mirror to Samsung TV

Enjoy your phone's screen on your TV with wireless screen mirroring. Share apps, photos, websites, presentations, games and other compatible content on a larger display.

Use screen mirroring when you want to:

• Mirror your phone screen to your TV
• View mobile content on a bigger display
• Share photos and videos with family
• Browse content on a larger screen
• Enjoy compatible games on your TV
• Give presentations or show content from your phone

🎛️ Smart TV Remote Features

Depending on your compatible TV and connection, the app can also provide convenient TV control features from your phone.

Use the remote interface for supported functions such as:

• Navigation
• Volume control
• Channel control
• Playback controls
• Power control
• Menu navigation
• Other supported TV controls

Connect your compatible phone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network and start your big-screen experience.

🎬 Cast Movies & Videos

Watch your favorite videos on the big screen instead of using your phone's smaller display.

Smart View for Samsung TV lets you cast compatible video content from your phone to your TV for a more comfortable viewing experience.

Enjoy:

• Movies and videos
• Personal video collections
• Online-compatible video content
• Photos and media
• Music and other supported content

Move your entertainment from your phone to your TV and enjoy it on a larger display.

🎮 Play Games on the Big Screen

Take your mobile gaming experience to a larger display.

Mirror compatible games from your phone to your TV and enjoy a more immersive gaming experience. Your phone remains the source while the TV provides the larger viewing experience.

For the best experience, keep your phone and TV connected to a strong and stable Wi-Fi network.

📱 Cast Photos, Videos & Music

Share your favorite memories and media with friends and family.

Display photos from your phone on your TV, play compatible videos, and enjoy supported music con

quotes.text:
I was trying to mirror my Android smartphone to my Samsung TV to show a webpage to someone. This feature is called "Smart View" in the TV's menu, but I didn't know how to connect, so I searched that name in the Google Play store. There are dozens of results, only one of them is the official app that has any chance of working. There are two apps[1][2] that actually appear to be the same app just with slightly different names presumably so they appear twice in the search results. One app[3] has some very suspicious ratings and I can't help but notice that the publisher's name is "SmartThings.net" which appears to add more credibility until you see the domain has nothing to do with the app. I understand it can be hard for Google to vet these apps but some of these failures (like verifying you actually own the domain you are pretending to be affiliated with) seem like they could be automated.

Edit: spelling

    1. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.screenmirror.forvizio.smarttv.screenshare
    2. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.smartview.castto.screenmirror.appfor.miracast
    3. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.smartview.screen.mirroring
